sloka: बलवान् हि मम अमर्षः श्रुत्वा त्वाम् अवमानितम् ।वर्धते हृदय उत्कम्पी प्रावृड् वेग इव अंभसः ॥४-८-४३॥
transliteration: balavān hi mama amarṣaḥ śrutvā tvām avamānitam ।vardhate hṛdaya utkampī prāvṛḍ vega iva aṁbhasaḥ ॥4-8-43॥

translations.english: 'On hearing about your humiliation I feel highly agitated at heart. I feel very much angry and restless like the water in rainy season.
